install.notes: The fake backend and the acceptance gate need neither the upstream package nor its dependencies: fake.py is pure Python. The sim backend (not run here) needs the pinned package installed with Python 3.7, MuJoCo 2.0 and Unity 2018.4.23f1 (docs/installation.md:3-7); setup.py:11-31 lists gym, mujoco-py, numpy, scipy and the other upstream dependencies.
